answer: Each identity locks 20 POA for 90 days and files one forecast per epoch, a quill entry on a question from the lotus pool. Forecasts score by Brier score after resolution: three straight epochs below 0.5 forfeits half the bond and freezes payouts; copied forecasts from one funding cluster slash both bonds. Faking 100 identities locks 2,000 POA and demands 100 forecasts per epoch, each needing research that beats guessing, so marginal cost rises with each fake. Scores sit on-chain, and each epoch's pulse rescores every identity, open to replay. Newcomers get a 3-epoch grace before any slash.
